Wynton HPC is a large, shared high-performance compute (HPC) cluster
underlying UCSF's Research Computing Capability. Funded and
administered cooperatively by UCSF campus IT and key research groups,
it is available to all UCSF researchers, and consists of different
profiles suited to various biomedical and health science computing
needs. Researchers can participate using the “co-op” model of resource
contribution and sharing.

The Wynton HPC environment is available for free to all UCSF
researchers.

For more information, including how to join, please visit
<https://wynton.ucsf.edu/hpc/>.
